description: GGUF container lane: llama.cpp-native serving, plus vLLM via the in-tree (<=0.19) or vllm-gguf-plugin (>=0.23) GGUF path. One container, one kernel family: only ggml tensor types are expressible, so the non-GGUF quantized formats are structurally unavailable rather than policy-denied.

format_rules.detail: GGUF artifacts can only carry ggml tensor types; K-quants Q2_K..Q6_K + Q8_0 have CUDA MMQ/MMVQ/fused-MoE kernels in both llama.cpp and the vLLM GGUF path, BF16 is the unquantized passthrough (written as BF16/F16 tensor). IQ formats stay research-only until their slower prefill path (MMVQ/Triton, no MMQ) passes a serving perf gate.

shape_rules.detail: GGUF k-quants pack 256-element superblocks along the input dim
Q8_0 packs 32-element blocks along the input dim
